reason: Schedule and feasibility lens: the idea survives. It is the cheapest idea to put on the LB: one --set, no new code, no new dataset, no friend A, no lab. The weak point is informativeness, not the calendar. CHECKS. (1) Implementable as described, with no code change. exp56 cell 0 l.93-103 sets READMIT_MIN_SCORE 0.965, READMIT_RADIUS_UM 4, GAPFILL_MIN_SCORE 0.5, GAPFILL_MAX_ADDED_FRAC 0.03 and LOWDET 0.3; cell 2 l.82-91 reads them from env. Readmit (cell 5 l.1250-1300) takes its pool from load_low_detections (l.1180-1245): dump peaks >= GAPFILL_MIN_SCORE 0.5 that lie > 2.0 um from any node. It then keeps the peaks >= READMIT_MIN_SCORE within 4 um of an open end at t-1 or an open start at t+1. Any value in [0.5, 0.965) therefore works through env alone, and 0.85 is valid; going below 0.5 would also move the gap filler, a confound. tools/build_probe_kernel.py --base x138 accepts --set: overrides are appended to cell 0 after the base values (l.1524-1530), the base is sha256-checked, and the divinsert patch composes, so the probe can be built on exp57b if #35 wins. Build time ~0.3 agent-h. (2) The gap filler reloads the pool against the updated node set (l.1326-1327), so a readmitted peak cannot be reused as a bridge node, and the change creates no duplicates. (3) Runtime is not at risk. The extra nodes are ~1-2% (1,337 readmits of 121,777 at 0.965, CONTEXT.md l.1515; 1.5-3x that at 0.85). The only added cost is a slightly larger second motion relink, well inside REPAIR_DEADLINE_S 27000 and the 12 h limit. (4) One part cannot be implemented as described. The conditional 'widen GAPFILL_MAX_ADDED_FRAC if the dummy log shows the budget binding' has no log line. 'gapfill_budget_hit' only goes into filter_stats, which is never printed or saved (cell 5 l.2121-2140). Binding has to be INFERRED from two printed lines, 'gap filler: +A nodes' and 'after gap-closing ...: N nodes': binding iff A >= round(0.03*(N-A)) - 3. Any 4-dummy-clip readout is also only an in-sample sanity check. (5) Cited numbers check out: the 2 um exclusion and 4 um radius, 1,337/121,777, readmit-v1 0.946 -> x138 0.953 (browser_research_2026-09-24.md l.58/116/120), and leaf prune removing readmits (CONTEXT l.1511-1516; 'never combine' is right). The +0.001-0.002 is the idea's own guess. SCHEDULE. The binding constraints are vitalii's GPU (~0 GPU-h until 26 Sep 00:00 UTC; the commit/dummy run needs a T4) and the user being awake to push and approve. The earliest realistic commit is 26 Sep 05:00-07:00 UTC, scored 26 Sep ~15:00-18:00 UTC, which leaves ~64 h of slack to 29 Sep 10:00. It uses 1 of 20 slots and ~0.7 GPU-h. P(scored by the deadline) ~0.9, or ~0.8 counting the #34 base-reproduction risk (if #34 < 0.952, x138 is not the base and the probe is moot for the finals). THE REAL WEAKNESS is that the probe is scoreable but hardly readable. The adopt gate is >= base + 0.003, the expected effect is +0.000..+0.002, and LB noise is ~0.003 (byte-identical notebooks at 0.946/0.942, BRIEF). So P(true adopt) is low, and a single arm gives a false adopt ~15-25% of the time at zero true effect (GUESS, from that noise). The repair below fixes this.
fix_if_any: (a) Build on the base that wins #34/#35 (exp56, or exp57b via --patch divinsert). Use one command: python tools/build_probe_kernel.py exp58_x138_readmit085 --base x138 [--patch divinsert --set DIVINS_ENABLE=... as in exp57b] --set READMIT_MIN_SCORE=0.85. Keep GAPFILL_MAX_ADDED_FRAC unchanged in the first probe, so each probe has one knob. (b) Budget readout: infer binding per clip from the log as A >= round(0.03*(N-A)) - 3, where A comes from 'gap filler: +A nodes' and N from 'after gap-closing: N nodes'. If you want it explicit, add a one-line print of stats['gapfill_budget_hit']; that would be a code patch, so a builder change plus a no-op test. (c) Replace the single-arm +0.003 gate with a 2-arm dose-response pair on the same day: arm A 0.85 and arm B 0.75, both >= GAPFILL_MIN_SCORE 0.5 so there is no confound. ADOPT into a final only if both arms are >= base and arm A is >= base + 0.002, or if a single arm reaches >= base + 0.004. Otherwise revert. That costs 2 of 20 slots and cuts the false-adopt rate roughly in half (GUESS). (d) Pre-registered dummy sanity check (4 clips, in-sample, sanity only): readmitted 1.5-3x of 1,337; final nodes <= +1.5% vs exp56; forks unchanged; repair_fallback 0; no REPAIR FAILED. (e) Never combine with leafprune. Keep it off the pipeline stages other probes are testing that day, so the LB delta can be attributed.
realistic_public_gain: +0.000..+0.002 (GUESS, the idea's own range; no in-sample or LB evidence either way). The probe cannot resolve anything below ~+0.003 against LB noise ~0.003.
realistic_private_gain: +0.000..+0.002 (GUESS). The mechanism leans on detector peak scores in 0.85-0.965, a sub-threshold band. On unseen embryos their calibration may differ, so the sign could flip on denser private embryos (more free peaks next to open ends). This is low risk because failed readmits end up isolated and are pruned for free.
critical_path: 25 Sep 12:00-13:00 UTC, agent (container, CPU): prepare the build commands for arms A (0.85) and B (0.75) on both candidate bases, the dry build and diff check (only cell 0 changes; sha check passes), and the log-parse script for the readout. No push. 25 Sep ~17:00-20:00 UTC: #34/#35 score; choose the base (exp56, or exp57b if #35 > #34). If #34 < 0.952, x138 is not the base and the line is dropped (P ~0.15). 26 Sep 00:00 UTC: vitalii's Kaggle GPU quota resets. 26 Sep ~05:00-07:00 UTC (08:00-10:00 MSK), user (or the main session with the Kaggle key the user offered, after his explicit OK): push both kernels (2 concurrent sessions allowed). Each commit runs the 4 dummy clips on a T4, ~20-40 min, ~0.7 GPU-h each. 26 Sep ~07:00-07:30: agent parses the logs (readmitted count, final nodes, forks, budget inference, no REPAIR FAILED) against the pre-registered sanity band. 26 Sep ~07:30-08:30: the user OKs and submits both (2 of 5 slots on 26 Sep). Scored 26 Sep ~15:00-18:30 UTC (7-10 h latency). Slack to 29 Sep 10:00 UTC is ~63 h, enough for a rerun on 27 Sep (for example a 0.05 budget arm) if an arm crashes or the budget binds. Friend A, Colab and new datasets are not on the path; the weights are x138's attached datasets. P(scored by the deadline) ~0.9 given x138 is the base, ~0.8 unconditional.
